card.name: Kidney function and body-size calculation formulas
card.fires_on: Small words and punctuation inside instructions for calculating kidney function or body surface area, such as 'using the' before a named formula, or the point in 1.73 m2. Seen in creatinine clearance, eGFR and BSA text.
